description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages a detailed content information screen with UI setup, content data population, focus handling for navigation, and user interaction logic, including button focus animations and intent creation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about a TV program, including channel info, program title, metadata, background, and action buttons with focus management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI, populates content data, and sets up focusable action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Displays current system date and time in the top-right corner.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Retrieves intent extras or defaults to populate the screen with program information.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, sets icons and labels, and configures focus and click listeners.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates focus gain/loss on action buttons, enlarging or reducing their size and elevation.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles the logic executed when an action button is pressed, including a click animation.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an Intent with content metadata for starting this activity.
